rules.description: Every CIK in raw.xbrl_company_facts has an approved mapping in base.entity_mappings
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.cik) as unmapped FROM raw.xbrl_company_facts r LEFT JOIN base.entity_mappings m ON r.cik = m.cik AND m.status = 'approved' WHERE m.cik IS NULL
rules.rationale: No raw entity should be orphaned without a canonical mapping

rules.description: No duplicate CIKs in approved mappings
rules.sql: SELECT cik, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM base.entity_mappings WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY cik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rules.rationale: Each CIK maps to exactly one canonical entity

rules.description: All confidence scores between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.entity_mappings WHERE confidence < 0.0 OR confidence > 1.0
rules.rationale: Confidence is a probability — must be in [0, 1]

rules.description: Approved mappings have non-null approved_by and approved_at
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.entity_mappings WHERE status = 'approved' AND (approved_by IS NULL OR approved_at IS NULL)
rules.rationale: Every approval must be traceable to an actor and timestamp

rules.description: Every audit entry has a valid mapping_id that exists in entity_mappings
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base.entity_resolution_audit a LEFT JOIN base.entity_mappings m ON a.mapping_id = m.mapping_id WHERE m.mapping_id IS NULL
rules.rationale: Audit entries must reference real mappings
